# Astro Spatial

AI-native spatial pages for Astro and Three.js.

## Authoring rules

- Keep HTML semantic and accessible; use the canvas as progressive enhancement.
- Use stable kebab-case IDs for every scene and node.
- Prefer GLB for imported assets and procedural factories for editable code assets.
- Provide a fallback and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
- Do not add physics, multiplayer, or WebGPU-only behavior to the core without an explicit extension.

## Components

### Scene (astro-component)

Mounts one validated spatial scene with a semantic canvas and static fallback.

Props:
- `id`: stable kebab-case scene identifier
- `nodes`: array of validated spatial nodes
- `label`: accessible canvas label
- `fallback`: static fallback text
- `maxDpr`: positive number, defaults to 1.5
- `quality`: low, medium, or high performance budget

### Model (scene-node)

References an imported GLB/glTF model.

Props:
- `id`: stable kebab-case node identifier
- `src`: public model URL or asset path
- `position`: three-number array
- `rotation`: three-number array
- `scale`: number or three-number array

### Camera (scene-node)

Declares a camera node inside a Scene using stable authoring props.

Props:
- `id`: stable kebab-case node identifier
- `position`: three-number array
- `target`: three-number array
- `fov`: positive field of view number

### Light (scene-node)

Declares an ambient, directional, or point light node inside a Scene.

Props:
- `id`: stable kebab-case node identifier
- `type`: ambient, directional, or point
- `intensity`: non-negative light intensity
- `position`: three-number array

### Environment (scene-node)

Declares a scene environment background or optional environment asset source.

Props:
- `id`: stable kebab-case node identifier
- `src`: optional environment asset URL
- `background`: optional CSS/Three.js color string

### ProceduralModel (scene-node)

References an editable TypeScript procedural model factory, including img2threejs-style output.

Props:
- `id`: stable kebab-case node identifier
- `src`: factory module URL or asset path
- `position`: three-number array
- `rotation`: three-number array
- `scale`: number or three-number array

### Story (astro-component)

Renders semantic chapters and publishes deterministic native-scroll progress events.

Props:
- `id`: stable story identifier
- `chapters`: array of id, title, body, and optional scrollWeight objects
